newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's Dave Thomas to have heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's Dave Thomas to have heart surgery.

text.p: The founder and spokesman of the Wendy's fast-food restaurant chain, Dave Thomas, will have coronary bypass surgery this week, a company spokesman said Monday.

The serious-looking Thomas, 64, is featured in television advertisements for Wendy's International Inc., which serves hamburgers, french fries and other fast-food fare out of 4,800 Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburgers Restaurants worldwide.

Over the weekend, Thomas, who founded the chain in 1969 but is no longer involved in day-to-day operations, was admitted into an undisclosed hospital suffering from chest pains. He has no prior history of a heart condition, the company said.
